context: A retired official catches up with a teacher about a book launch
purpose: Teach: 厚生省/秘書/開幕/食糧/原油/入国/懇談/刊行

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: やあ、麻生先生。ご無沙汰しております。先日の刊行記念会、まことに盛会でしたな。
lines.en: Ah, Asuka-sensei. It's been a while. The other day's publication launch event was truly a great success.
lines.style: Warm elder greeting, dignified and slightly formal, congratulatory tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ご無沙汰しております、麻生先生。いえ、先生こそ開幕のご挨拶、本当に心に残りました。
lines.en: It's been a while, Asuka-sensei. No, it was your opening address that really stayed with me.
lines.style: Polite teacher's voice, respectful and genuinely moved, soft cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: いやはや、現役の頃は厚生省にいましてね、若い秘書に原稿を直されながら話したものですよ。
lines.en: Goodness, back when I was active I was at the Ministry of Welfare, having my young secretary correct my drafts.
lines.style: Nostalgic reminiscing, self-deprecating chuckle, leisurely retired pace.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうでしたね。食糧政策のお話、生徒たちにも読ませたいくらいです。
lines.en: That's right. Your stories about food policy — I'd want my students to read them.
lines.style: Admiring, teacherly enthusiasm, sincere praise without flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 原油高の頃の入国制限の話など、今思えばずいぶん荒っぽい議論をしておりました。
lines.en: Looking back, our discussions about immigration restrictions during the oil price spike were rather rough.
lines.style: Reflective elder, slightly rueful, weighing past mistakes thoughtfully.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ぜひ今度、生徒との懇談の場にお越しいただけませんか。きっと示唆に富むお話になります。
lines.en: Please, would you come to a discussion session with my students sometime? It would surely be full of insight.
lines.style: Earnest invitation, warm teacherly hope, slightly tentative request.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 光栄ですな。この歳でお役に立てるなら、喜んで伺いますよ。
lines.en: What an honor. If I can be useful at this age, I'll gladly come.
lines.style: Humble acceptance, gentle elder warmth, quietly pleased.
